name: NTP Time Server (Chrony)
description: Configure system time synchronization, local NTP server daemon, upstream pool servers, and force clock sync

commands.get_time_info_cmd: date && echo '===TZ===' && cat /etc/timezone 2>/dev/null || timedatectl | grep 'Time zone'
commands.sync_time_sudo: chronyc makestep 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart chrony || service chrony restart
commands.restart_ntp_sudo: systemctl restart chrony || service chrony restart
